summary: Trip.com Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited second-quarter and first-half 2026 results, with CFO Cindy Xiaofan Wang signing. Q2 net revenue was RMB15.7bn (US$2.3bn), up 6% year over year but down 3% sequentially; diluted loss per share/ADS was RMB3.89 (US$0.57), while non-GAAP diluted EPS/ADS was RMB7.27 (US$1.07) versus RMB7.20. International platform revenue rose over 50% year over year; accommodation revenue RMB6.6bn reflects a SAMR contra-revenue. No transaction, no deal terms.
